name: Bigfiles
summary: Finds heavy folders and checks recent activity before I decide what to archive.
story: A Mac accumulates the sediment of every company, course, podcast, trip, and project. Bigfiles is the map before the excavation.

launcher.long: Scans your Mac and lists the largest folders and files by size, so you can see where the disk space actually went — old simulators, unused VMs, forgotten videos.
